items.title: Salt Hour
items.logline: A marine biologist returns to a dwindling fjord village to bury her brother and finds his last research notebook submerged offshore.
items.synopsis: Inge has not been home in eleven years. As autumn light shortens over the fjord, she retraces her brother's solitary winters among the fishermen who refuse to speak of him. What she lifts from the water will not be the truth she expected, only its shape.

items.title: The Paper Lantern Boy
items.logline: In a mountain town where forgotten names take physical form, a lantern-maker's apprentice befriends a boy nobody else can remember.
items.synopsis: Each dusk Tarou lights the lanterns that keep the valley's memories from drifting. When a barefoot child appears at his workshop with no name and no shadow, Tarou begins carrying him through the streets, asking strangers a question none can answer.

items.title: A Quiet Inheritance
items.logline: Three siblings gather in Isfahan to divide their father's pistachio orchard, until a notary discovers a fourth name on the deed.
items.synopsis: The Tabatabai children have not stood in the same room since the funeral. Across one suffocating week of negotiations, polite arguments harden into accusations, and the housekeeper's silence becomes the loudest voice in the room. By the final meeting, only one of them still wants the land.

items.title: Vultures Over Pampa
items.logline: A veterinary inspector traveling the dry Patagonian plains stumbles onto a livestock fraud that reaches into the governor's family.
items.synopsis: Esteban drives for days between failing ranches, signing certificates he no longer reads. After a widow asks him to look at her dead cattle, he begins to count the brands. The further south he goes, the fewer people seem willing to say his name out loud.
